source: Quran.com (text_uthmani) as shown on quran.com 58:1. Excerpt = the part the narrator reads (up to تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ). Re-run verse_check before publishing.

58:1.arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
58:1.translation: Allah has heard the woman who argues with you about her husband and complains to Allah. And Allah hears the two of you talking.
